title: test experiment creation: pass an explicit tmp_path artifact_location so test runs do not write into the shared repo-root mlruns/ directory
answers: Test artifacts appeared in the repo-root mlruns/ folder and parallel test workers failed or lost files during cleanup
Why do the checkpoint import tests pass a tmp_path artifact_location to mlflow.create_experiment?
Where is the experiment artifact location set for tests that create an experiment and log a model or run?
How do I write a new test that creates an experiment without writing to the shared mlruns directory?
body:
Path: tests/tracking/test_client.py:test_log_model_artifact, test_log_model_artifacts, test_log_model_artifact_with_artifact_path, test_log_model_artifacts_with_artifact_path (MlflowClient.create_experiment followed by create_logged_model and log_model_artifact(s)); tests/tracking/fluent/test_fluent.py:test_create_external_model (mlflow.create_experiment followed by start_run), and the checkpoint-import tests test_import_checkpoints_overwrite, test_import_checkpoints_skip_name_with_invalid_char, test_import_checkpoints_without_run (mlflow.create_experiment followed by checkpoint import); tests/test_mlflow_version_comp.py:test_mlflow_2_x_comp (2.x vs 3.x tracking compatibility).
Rule: When a test creates an experiment, pass artifact_location=(tmp_path / "exp-artifacts").as_uri() to MlflowClient.create_experiment or mlflow.create_experiment; any subdirectory name under tmp_path works (e.g. "artifacts"). Without it, the experiment inherits the default location, which resolves to the shared ./mlruns directory and races with xdist cleanup.
Symptom: Test artifacts appeared in the repo-root mlruns/ folder, and parallel test workers intermittently failed or lost files when cleanup ran while other tests were writing there.
Constraints: Applies to tests that create experiments and write artifacts or runs. Not needed for tests that never create an experiment or only read a pre-built fixture location.
applies: Test code under tests/ that calls create_experiment (including the checkpoint-import tests in tests/tracking/fluent/test_fluent.py); the fix is per-test, not a change to the tracking library.
